desc:
Turn equations into your next winning shot!

💡 Type a function, choose +x or −x, and fire your curve across the arena.
🎯 Bend shots around cover, chip holes through obstacles, and hit multiple players for combos.
🧱 Battle across Stud Yard, Brick Crossing, and Star Park with a fresh obstacle layout each match.
🌀 Charge your equipped Teleport or Missile ability by landing shots.
🎓 Try practice challenges, learn equation tips, and aim for the top of the class.
✨ Earn light bulbs to unlock titles, outfits, hats, and shot trails.

Every supported math function is free to use. Tip packs give you ideas to try; they do not unlock functions. VIP packs are permanent in-game cosmetics.

Bring a friend: matches start with 2 players. Last player standing wins!
